description:
Closes #1702 

# PR: Add Hiredis as Default Redis Parser

## Summary

- Add hiredis C parser as the default Redis protocol parser for up to 83x faster response parsing
- Update docker-compose defaults to use both Granian (HTTP server) and hiredis (Redis parser) for maximum performance
- Provide fallback options for environments where these aren't suitable

## Changes

### Core Implementation

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `pyproject.toml` | Changed `redis` extra to `redis[hiredis]>=7.1.0`, added `redis-pure` fallback |
| `mcpgateway/config.py` | Added `redis_parser` setting (auto/hiredis/python) |
| `mcpgateway/utils/redis_client.py` | Added parser selection logic with `_is_hiredis_available()`, `_get_parser_class()`, `get_redis_parser_info()` |

### Configuration & Documentation

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `.env.example` | Added `REDIS_PARSER` with performance benchmarks |
| `docker-compose.yml` | Changed defaults: `HTTP_SERVER=granian`, `REDIS_PARSER=hiredis` |
| `docs/docs/manage/configuration.md` | Added `REDIS_PARSER` setting |
| `docs/docs/architecture/adr/026-hiredis-redis-parser.md` | New ADR documenting decision |
| `docs/docs/architecture/adr/index.md` | Added ADR-026 to index |

### Container & Tests

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `Containerfile.lite` | Fixed missing `docker-entrypoint.sh` in COPY command |
| `tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_redis_client.py` | Added parser selection tests |

## Performance Benchmarks

| Operation | Pure Python | With Hiredis | Improvement |
|-----------|-------------|--------------|-------------|
| Simple SET/GET | Baseline | +10% | 1.1x |
| LRANGE (10 items) | Baseline | +170% | 2.7x |
| LRANGE (100 items) | Baseline | +900% | ~10x |
| LRANGE (999 items) | Baseline | +8220% | **83x** |

## Configuration Options

```bash
# Redis parser (docker-compose default: hiredis)
REDIS_PARSER=hiredis  # C extension, fastest
REDIS_PARSER=auto     # Use hiredis if available, fallback to python
REDIS_PARSER=python   # Pure-Python, useful for debugging

# HTTP server (docker-compose default: granian)
HTTP_SERVER=granian   # Rust-based, fastest
HTTP_SERVER=gunicorn  # Python-based with Uvicorn workers
```

## Installation Options

```bash
# Default: includes hiredis
pip install "mcp-contextforge-gateway[redis]"

# Pure-Python only (no C dependencies)
pip install "mcp-contextforge-gateway[redis-pure]"
```

## Verification

- [x] All 20 Redis client tests pass
- [x] All 71 Redis-related tests pass
- [x] Code quality checks pass (flake8, black, isort)
- [x] Docker compose starts successfully with new defaults
- [x] Health check passes
- [x] Hiredis 3.3.0 confirmed installed in container

## Related

- Issue: #1702
- ADR: 026-hiredis-redis-parser.md
- Similar pattern: ADR-025 (Granian HTTP Server)
